about_short_description.short_description: Insify is an insurance company that offers digital insurance solutions to freelancers and small businesses.

product.name: Arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering (Disability Insurance)
product.description: Income protection for freelancers and small-business owners who cannot work temporarily or permanently because of illness or an accident.

product.name: Bedrijfsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering (Business Liability Insurance)
product.description: Coverage for bodily injury or physical property damage caused to customers, clients, or other third parties during business activities.

product.name: Beroepsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering (Professional Indemnity Insurance)
product.description: Coverage for financial losses suffered by clients because of professional errors, incorrect advice, or omissions.

identifier.value: Inventaris- en goederenverzekering (Business Inventory and Goods Insurance)

product.name: Inventaris- en goederenverzekering (Business Inventory and Goods Insurance)
product.description: Insurance for a business’s inventory, equipment, and other physical goods against covered damage or loss.

product.name: Elektronicaverzekering (Electronics Insurance)
product.description: Coverage for business electronics such as laptops and other devices used in professional activities.

product.name: Autoverzekering (Car Insurance)
product.description: Motor insurance for cars used privately, commercially, or in both personal and business contexts.
